title: The Four Great Days and the Four Counterfeit Nights
description: The architecture of redemption laid out as four great Days, each emanated from the one before, with twelve hours each, set against four corresponding Nights with twelve shadows. Father of Greatness (twelve gods spread through four climes), Third Ambassador (twelve virgins in the ship of light), Pillar of Glory (Five Sons, Five Sons of Living Spirit, Call and Hearing), and Jesus the Radiance (twelve wisdoms). Their counterparts: Land of Darkness, Hyle, fleshly worlds, the law of the Old Man.
